description: Implementation of the FFMPEGDispatch interface for dynamically loading FFmpeg symbols and managing FFmpeg library interactions.

classes.name: FFMPEGDispatch
classes.description: Class responsible for loading FFmpeg symbols and providing an interface to interact with FFmpeg library.

methods.name: FFMPEGDispatch
methods.description: Constructor that loads FFmpeg symbols and registers all formats.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FFMPEGDispatch, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: RegisterSpecialization
methods.description: Registers a specific FFmpeg library specialization; always returns true as only one version is linked.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the FFmpeg dispatch object is valid; always true for linked library.

methods.name: specialization_version
methods.description: Returns the version of FFmpeg linked; always FFMPEG.
